snapshotContract.freeze: Selected adapter GithubMainFreeze in main-freeze.mjs: operator-owned GitHub token locks main through branch protection lock_branch=true/enforce_admins=true, with force/deletion/bypass disabled and existing protection retained. If repository policy cannot enforce lock or credentials lack permission, fail before capture. Drain/reconcile legacy claims and provider callbacks before capturing closure. Lock remains until postcommit verification or explicit abort restores saved protection. No SQLite transaction is claimed to lock Git; remote lock observation and operator ownership are explicit prerequisites.
snapshotContract.storage: Fetch exact Git objects and refs before freeze; resolve via git show SHA:path and actual blob modes, never current checkout files. Evidence/log/receipt closure hashes checked; required external blobs must be retained and readable. Research baseline count is only a historical calibration fixture. Worker enumerates a fresh locked snapshot at execution.
snapshotContract.barrier: After quiesce on writable main, maintenance CAS records nonce/revision and denies actor allocation/publication/renewal/reconciliation in both legacy and isolated V2. Readers remain; only operator freeze/migration allowed. Confirm hard GitHub lock and recheck zero claims/callbacks; bind incumbent V2 set. Any lock/race failure restores barrier/protection before import. Release only after complete postchecks or precommit abort.
snapshotContract.quiesce: Pause new legacy admission, finish normal publications on unlocked main, require zero active legacy claims/callbacks; then hard maintenance/native main lock and fresh recheck. Race aborts; no synthetic cleanup. Existing isolated V2 set hash-bound after hard barrier.

importAuthorityContract.schema: LEGACY_IMPORT_RECEIPT_V1={id,workId,newGeneration:1,legacySnapshotSha,legacyTaskHash,old:{objectiveRef/hash,planRef/semanticHash,readinessEvalRef/hash?,candidateEvalRef/hash?,candidateInputRef/hash?},new:{semanticSpecHash,objectiveHash,planHash,edgeProjectionHash,componentProjectionHash,scopeHash,phase,importAttemptRef?,versionRefs},validatorControllerDigest}. Bridge resolver requires both projections equal, current Work gen1/spec equals new binding; readiness applicability ignores later Attempt/candidate/evidence changes, candidate applicability requires exact accepted versions; same-purpose native Decision overrides bridge even nonSAT, and original trusted validation successful. old also includes originalExpectedInputRef/hash (full typed original evaluator input, not producer reconstructed flags). Store has corresponding immutable source/receipt blobs. Validate original before receipt insert; postflip lifecycle reads these V2 records only. new.purposeBindings={readiness:{workGeneration,semanticSpecHash,planHash},candidate?:{workGeneration,semanticSpecHash,versionRefs,candidateSha,candidateTree}}; derive from original validated subjects, never producer flags.

manifestBlueprint.algorithm: Read all tasks from locked SHA. Filter DONE into excludedDone; only exact valid BLOCKED WITHDRAWN marker into excludedWithdrawn; include all remaining tasks. Sort ids. Assert set(included) disjoint exclusions and union equals source task ids. Each included id resolves task/objective/plan/components/deps/phase-required authority to exact Git/blob/hash closure. Fail unknown withdrawal, duplicate id or unresolved ref; no sampling or hardcoded totals.
manifestBlueprint.tests: Fixture contains ordinary BLOCKED, withdrawn BLOCKED, DONE, planned research, READY Worker and MERGE_PENDING. Compare full expected included/excluded id arrays, then add an extra unfinished task and require one extra Work. Removal/duplicate/stale source reference must fail. Real Worker uses the same algorithm on its fresh frozen main manifest.
manifestBlueprint.withdrawalRule: Exclude DONE first; withdrawal only BLOCKED title with exact trusted [WITHDRAWN ...] bracketed prefix. Unknown/malformed status/title pairing or withdrawn dependency fails. Ordinary BLOCKED is included; all id sets exhaust snapshot.

transformBlueprint.mapping: Archive-derived semantic templates preserve id/inline bodies/hashes/edges/components/direct scopes; DONE edges use validated Living proof only. Native gen1/RV1 rows, pending controller Attempt/fence/Lease/version records and exact bridge bindings materialize inside uncommitted import transaction with store clock, then native parity before COMMIT. Original evaluator bytes/subject hashes unchanged.
transformBlueprint.tests: For EVERY manifest id, compare these fields against independently read source bodies/edges; assert unique Work per id. Tamper goal,plan,edge,component,scope or required receipt: transform/parity aborts. Preserve MERGE_PENDING candidate/tree/evidence; no DONE row is emitted for a Living dependency.
transformBlueprint.wire: Use exact BB-155 Work wire: {id,resourceVersion:1,generation:1,spec:{objective:{ref,hash,body},plan:{ref,semanticHash,body}|null,dependencies:[{workId,requires,source:WORK|LIVING,binding?}],components,writeScope,forbiddenWrite,labels,provenance},status:{phase,observedGeneration:1,activeAttemptRef:null,activeLeaseRef:null,candidateVersionRef:null,evidenceVersionRef:null,readinessDecisionRef:null,latestCandidateDecisionRef:null,deliveryReceiptRef:null,conditions:[],dependencyFacts,leaseState:NONE,blockers:[],importAuthorityRef}}. Optional refs/phase facts replaced only by validated phase-specific native records/bridge; use optional BB-157 failureAnchorRef/repairReflectionRef only when exact applicable authority exists. readScope remains plan/component context data; no unsupported spec.scopes field. Strict schema validation must pass every prepared Work.

parityBlueprint.tests: Every phase/id: positive parity; last-id dependency/scope/proof/action corruption aborts the whole transaction.
parityBlueprint.signature: assertMigrationParity({manifest,archive,nativeSnapshots,capabilities})->Report. Native snapshots resolve staged rows on commitMigration SQL handle; all raw guards/actions and semantic diffs retained.
algorithmSteps: Independently validate every source authority/closure with archived shipped validators. Derive all comparisonFields; retain blocked context and absent judge/main proof as disabled mutations.

Within commitMigration stage real native rows/claims/versions using store clock. Same-handle readMigrationSnapshot(tx,id) resolves stored proofs/Living; actual pure nextActions/buildContext. No copied source flags, predicted clock, HTTP or second connection.

Remove maintenance ONLY from both comparison projections; actual apply blocked. Exact all-id field/guard equality and readonly continuation leases live at final store clock -> report/receipt COMMIT. Any diff/unknown/expiry -> full ROLLBACK.
parityBlueprint.legacyDerivation: At manifest SHA validate original authority with shipped assertReady/materialize/validateEvaluation/main/Living validators. taskReadiness is scheduling only. deriveDeliveryContext known BLOCKED/DEPENDENCIES_NOT_DONE becomes explicit blocker; other errors abort. Unclaimed PLANNED current scope=[], prospective plan scope retained. Compare exact edges/unfinished ids; research may proceed without delivered deps. REVIEW/PHASE_* never enables publication.

actionEquivalence.RESEARCH: Legacy claim+RESEARCH = START_RESEARCH with valid goal/components, no delivered-dependency guard. Product scope=[], plan output only.
actionEquivalence.EXECUTION: Legacy claim+IMPLEMENT = CLAIM_EXECUTION iff genuine current readiness and every direct dependency delivered. Exact blocker ids/readiness failure/plan scopes match; unclaimed current scope=[].
actionEquivalence.JUDGMENT: Legacy REVIEW/evaluate = pending native readiness/candidate judge diagnostic. PUBLISH_DECISION disabled until actual independent exact response. New readonly claim is protocol only, never acceptance.
actionEquivalence.MERGE_PENDING: Legacy verify/publish-delivery = VERIFY_MERGE diagnostic/PUBLISH_DELIVERY_RECEIPT. Mutation requires accepted exact candidate plus actual main/equal-tree/Living proof despite scheduler exclusion.
actionEquivalence.BLOCKED: Preserve STATUS_BLOCKED reason refs; no claim/product/provider effect.
actionEquivalence.unsupported: Drain active claims. Unreflected REPAIR/unknown authority aborts full manifest; resolve source legitimately and capture again.

parityBlueprint.comparisonRule: Normalize only action names and protocol CAS/token/lease encoding. Compare sorted guard atoms {name,subjectHash,expected,actual,satisfied}, dependency ids and product effects. Retain raw requiredInputs/forbidden/actions and every refinement. Renewal is ownership protocol only. Every product mutation has exactly one equivalent; missing/extra semantic guard/action, scope or blocker is a diff. Never suppress semantic differences.
parityBlueprint.reportSchema: Store Report={manifestHash,controllerDigest,perWork:[{id,legacy,v2,rawNativeActions,protocolRefinements,fieldDiffs,equal}],mismatchCount,checkedIdSetHash,reportHash}; exact manifest id set and zero diffs. Persist in SAME cutover COMMIT; caller report/equal is never authority.

cutoverBlueprint.prepare: S0-S5 fixture code accepted/merged/installed under LEGACY, docs activation-conditional. S6 drain, barrier/native lock, fresh source/destination/profile pins and complete prepare. Missing capability/race/claim aborts before import visibility.
cutoverBlueprint.commit: BEGIN IMMEDIATE: CAS LEGACY/ISOLATED_NEW_WORK revision; verify pinned profile/freeze/main/source/destination. Insert ALL Work/native controller claims/versions/typed proofs, stage V2/ALL_WORK selectors privately. Compute same-connection native snapshots and exhaustive parity against validated source; zero diff/full set/live leases required. Insert report+receipt+allocator, COMMIT. Any fault rolls back everything; WAL readers retain old state until commit. Identical receipt resolves lost response; conflicting manifest aborts.
cutoverBlueprint.post: Read service selector+receipt and all manifest Work ids; compare full set/hashes/next/context and reject every legacy write/current-work reader. Mark source routing docs/deprecated graph pointer non-authoritative in prepared cleanup; retained receipt blobs remain immutable external subjects. Only then release repository freeze. If response was lost, immutable receipt id+manifestHash identifies successful cutover; conflict/missing receipt is fatal. Postcommit failure never switches back or dual-writes.
cutoverBlueprint.surfaceChanges: S0b/S0c own every declared current router/CLI/CI/state/docs surface: V2 pinned service only, retired raw APIs reject; historical validators require frozen SHA. Legacy tests move to owned SHA fixtures, current verification uses service selector/Work. Preserve all evaluator/negative/main/tree/Living checks, zero skipped regressions.
cutoverBlueprint.transport: Implement HTTPS in server.mjs/transport.mjs without another store: server config adds tls:{certificateFile:absolute,keyFile:absolute}, url:https://HOST:PORT; client adds caFile:absolute, expected authorityId/controllerDigest/minProtocol and existing tokenFile:absolute/role. Node HTTPS validates CA/hostname, rejects downgrade/wrong cert/pins; loopback profile stays available. Operator installs certificate/keys/tokens outside checkout and verifies one same SQLite authority before freeze. Read-only GitHub probe from actual runner must reach this same authority with reader capability; remote unavailable or incompatible client aborts cutover. Candidate child receives no judge/operator/provider credentials. This owns remote legacy-current routing retirement; no per-run authority, fallback, deployment by research or hidden TLS choice.
cutoverBlueprint.retention: DONE/withdrawn Work are absent. Preserve original terminal Living Docs and Git backup, and raw immutable evidence still referenced by unfinished Work. Do not delete prior process/evidence storage just to make cutover appear complete; no long-lived legacy current-work parser remains.
cutoverBlueprint.routing: Public wrappers query pinned GET authority and validate protocol/controller. LEGACY legitimate operations remain until barrier; V2 uses service. Raw current APIs RETIRED before I/O; separate immutable SHA reads only. No transport/pin fallback.
